							                  <!--normalTemplateStart--><h1 class='oc-page-title '>Council Meetings</h1>


<p>Yarriambiack Shire Council is committed to transparent, accessible and community‑focused governance. To support this commitment, Council Meetings will be recorded and published on Council’s YouTube channel, with a link to the most recent recording added to this webpage, under the applicable tab.</p>
<p>Recordings will be made available within six (6) business hours of the meeting’s conclusion.</p>
<p>This approach ensures that community members can view Council Meetings at a time that suits them, with improved audio and visual clarity and a more reliable, user‑friendly viewing experience.</p>
<hr />

<p><strong>Please note that visitors are not permitted to enter the chambers before the Council Meeting commencement time, which is primarily at 9:30am.</strong></p>
